# Tailoring rules (fictional test profile)

- Keep it to one page. Never redesign the layout; only reorder, choose and reword.
- Use only facts in the fact bank. Never add a number, employer, technology or outcome.
- Rewording may shorten, swap synonyms and reorder clauses. It may not raise scope.
- Start each bullet with a past-tense verb.
- Never name Northwind's clients.
- No em dashes.

## Cover letters

- Only when the posting asks for one. About 350 words.
- Structure: the consulting work mapped to the team's work, one technical story, cardly in two
  sentences, why this role, a one-line thanks.
- Never mention visa status, CPT, sponsorship or salary.
